## Repo conventions
- Branch naming: `<feat|fix|refactor|chore>/<scope>`; conventional commits, atomic.
- Pydantic v2: `model_validate`, `model_dump`, `@field_validator`, `ConfigDict`.
- SQLAlchemy: `selectinload`/`joinedload` for relationships in list endpoints.
- TypeScript: no bare `any`; prefer `unknown` + narrowing.
- CRLF-safe writes on Windows when editing project text files (this dev box is macOS; preserve existing line endings of files we edit).

## Tooling and constraints
- Python venv path (Windows): `backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe`; on macOS: `backend/.venv/bin/python`.
- Backend validation may be blocked locally by missing Google ADC / Cloud SQL credentials — skip cloud-dependent tests if that's the only failure.
- Frontend builds run through `next build`.
- Observability: backend gated behind `ENABLE_OBSERVABILITY=true`, frontend RUM behind `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_RUM=true`. Runbooks live in `docs/observability/README.md`.

## Approval policy
- No interrupts for routine local work (read files, search code, edit files, focused doc/skill writes, targeted local validation).
- Escalate only for: network installs, missing creds, destructive ops, ambiguous product decisions, push/PR creation (orchestrator handles PR creation automatically per skill rules).
